column1: What is a cross-functional Agile Team?
column2: A team with the skills needed to define, build, test, and deliver its work.
column3: Cross-functional teams reduce reliance on handoffs to separate departments.

column1: What is an Agile Release Train (ART)?
column2: A long-lived group of Agile Teams and stakeholders aligned to deliver value together.
column3: The ART coordinates teams around a shared mission and cadence.

column1: Why do stable Agile Teams support better delivery?
column2: People can build relationships and improve their way of working over time.
column3: Stable teams avoid repeatedly losing shared knowledge when projects end.

column2: Practices that build quality into the work throughout development.
column3: Teams do not rely only on a final inspection to find defects.

column1: Why is test automation useful in a Continuous Delivery Pipeline?
column2: It provides repeatable feedback when changes are integrated.
column3: Automated tests help teams detect defects earlier and deliver changes more safely.

column2: Frequently combines changes and checks the integrated solution.
column3: Frequent integration exposes conflicts and defects earlier.

column1: What is the difference between deployment and release?
column2: Deployment places a solution in an environment. Release makes the functionality available to users.
column3: A team can deploy functionality before deciding when to make it available.

column1: What is the purpose of continuous exploration?
column2: Learn about customer needs and identify valuable solution options.
column3: Exploration connects discovery and feedback to the work that teams build.

column1: What is the goal of the Continuous Delivery Pipeline?
column2: Move changes from idea to release through coordinated workflows and automation.
column3: The pipeline supports frequent delivery of value when the business needs it.

column1: How does DevOps improve delivery across an ART?
column2: It promotes shared responsibility and collaboration across development and operations.
column3: Automation, feedback, and collaboration reduce delays between building and operating solutions.
